# Mesh Ariyawansa (Meshydra)

> Meshith "Mesh" Ariyawansa, known online as Meshydra (also written MeshHydra / Mesh Hydra), is a web designer, developer and Solutions Architect from Kandy, Sri Lanka. He builds websites, internal apps and automation, and likes helping small businesses succeed. meshydra.com is his personal showcase, not a freelance shop.
